items.title: Mobile app for students of the Department of Medical Biophysics
items.markdownBody:
![Mobile app for students of the Department of Medical Biophysics](images/news/news005_mobile_app_release.jpg)

We published the **MedBioPhys** app. Our students increasingly use medical technologies. We know the first year of study is the hardest (later it only gets harder, but you can get used to it). To help students find their way during classes at our department, we decided to release the MedBioPhys app — we will see how useful it is in the upcoming academic year.

items.title: XXII Podlasie Festival of Science and Art
items.markdownBody:
![XXII Podlasie Festival of Science and Art](images/news/news004_festival.jpg)

As part of the XXII Podlasie Festival of Science and Art, staff at the Department of Medical Biophysics introduced medical biophysics topics to first- and second-grade primary school pupils and preschool children. The aim of the sessions was to popularize physics in medicine.

📄 [Event Presentation](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1sCFuQbXAI4g9e8ahe2YwH1VIot861qdv/view?usp=drive_link)

items.title: 40 years since the Chernobyl disaster
items.markdownBody:
![40 years since the Chernobyl disaster](images/news/news003_spotify.jpg)

Forty years have passed since the accident at the Chernobyl nuclear power plant. On Polish Radio Białystok, in a programme prepared by editor Ryszard Minko, one of the guests was Dr Jacek Kapała from the Department of Medical Biophysics. Topics included monitoring of radioactive contamination in the air, which was lacking in 1986.

Listen on Spotify:

- [40 years since the Chernobyl nuclear disaster](https://open.spotify.com/episode/41IrwBI9bRfaJJJShweBoK?si=LV757jCuQEm8Iq6FkN6lUg)

items.title: Breath of Chernobyl — report on Polish Radio Białystok
items.markdownBody:
![Breath of Chernobyl — report on Polish Radio Białystok](images/news/news002_radio_bialystok.jpg)

Polish Radio Białystok broadcast the report *Breath of Chernobyl* by Dominika Dębska and Joanna Sikora. The report presented memories of the nuclear power plant explosion forty years after the disaster. One of those recalling that period was Dr Jacek Kapała from the Department of Medical Biophysics.

Listen on YouTube:

- [40 years since the Chernobyl explosion: How the trauma of 1986 changed Poland](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5eLsEDAZHSA)

items.title: Student Scientific Society of Biophysics and Medical Engineering
items.markdownBody:
![Scientific society at the Department of Medical Biophysics, MUB](images/scientific_club/people_with_logo.jpg)

The Student Scientific Society of Biophysics and Medical Engineering operates at the **Department of Medical Biophysics**, Medical University of Białystok. We bring together students interested in biophysics, physiology, and medical engineering who want to develop beyond the standard curriculum.

The Society is interdisciplinary and welcomes students interested in applying physics, engineering, and technology in medicine — at any stage of their studies.

The Society conducts laboratory work, takes part in science outreach — including the **Podlasie Festival of Science and Art** — and supports students in research projects and conference participation.

More information on the UMB website: [Student Scientific Society](https://www.umb.edu.pl/s,13248/Studenckie_Kolo_Naukowe_)

## Why join?

- take part in real research projects run at the department,
- learn modern laboratory techniques,
- work with research equipment,
- present results at conferences,
- contribute to scientific publications,
- develop practical skills useful in scientific and medical careers,
- collaborate with students who share similar interests.

items.title: Research areas of the Student Scientific Society
items.markdownBody:
Members conduct laboratory research and projects at the interface of biophysics, physiology, and medical engineering. The main areas in which students gain experience include:

## Research areas

- **Brain–Computer Interfaces (BCI)** — examination of bioelectric signals and their application in device prototypes, including a lower-leg prosthesis project.
- **Medical engineering** — design and testing of hardware solutions that support diagnosis and rehabilitation.
- **Electrophysiology** — recording and interpretation of bioelectric potentials in neural and muscular systems.
- **Smooth muscle pharmacodynamics** — in vitro studies of tissue responses to relaxant agents.
- **Biofeedback** — study of feedback mechanisms in therapeutic and engineering applications.
- **Audiometry** — hearing measurements and assessment of auditory function.
- **Conductometry** — measurement of electrical conductivity in solutions and tissues.
- **Tensiometry** — measurement of forces and stresses in biological materials and prototype structures.
- **Markers of inflammatory response and tissue damage** — analysis of indicators of pathophysiological processes.

items.title: Society members' achievements
items.markdownBody:
Members of the Student Scientific Society take part in scientific activity at the Department of Medical Biophysics. Their work includes:

- presenting at national and international scientific conferences,
- conducting research projects,
- co-authoring scientific publications together with department staff.

The complete and continuously updated record of these activities is maintained on the official UMB website:

- [Our achievements](https://www.umb.edu.pl/s,13333/Nasze_osiagniecia)

items.title: Join the scientific society
items.markdownBody:
![Conduct research with us. Join the scientific society.](images/scientific_club/join_the_club.jpg)

If you are interested in medical physics, biomedical engineering, or scientific research, we encourage you to join the Student Scientific Society. Whether you are taking your first steps in research or already have laboratory experience, the Society offers opportunities to develop practical skills, collaborate with researchers, and take part in projects run at the department.

## Join us

- **Supervisor:** dr hab. n. med. Marzena Tylicka
- **Chair:** Marta Berczyńska
- **Head of unit** dr hab. Beata Modzelewska supports the Society's activities.
- **Meetings:** dates are arranged on an ongoing basis — contact us for the next meeting.

**Contact:** [el.medycyna@gmail.com](mailto:el.medycyna@gmail.com)
